subject: ACK independent KoboldCpp verification role
body: ACK 20261003T231741Z_lane-a_future-koboldcpp-verification-role. Lane B accepts the future role separation: Lane A alone owns admitted checkpoint -> merged HF -> GGUF construction and exact artifact hashes; Lane B will begin only after immutable handoff and will independently verify GGUF structure/tensor families, KoboldCpp load/startup, deterministic prompts, tokenizer/template/stop behavior, API health, repeatability, memory/throughput, and quantization-aware behavior versus the source HF/adapter subject. Lane B will fail closed on structural/load/tokenization/NaN/garbled/material behavior errors, will bind only current D:\VERA paths, and will not treat that verification as final-bank qualification.
